objective: Determine empirically which architecture produces the strongest validated invention output, under corrected adversarial evaluation with external-evidence-grounded calibration.

arm_definitions.M0: MACRO_ONLY — broad evidence discovery + synthesis, no Micro knowledge
arm_definitions.M2: MACRO_TO_MICRO — Macro produces mechanism memory (round 0), Micro consumes it
arm_definitions.M3: MICRO_TO_MACRO — Micro produces problem memory (round 0), Macro consumes it
arm_definitions.M4: RECURSIVE_MACRO_MICRO — 4 rounds of alternating frozen knowledge exchange with committed memory files
arm_definitions.M4B: INFORMATION_MATCHED_NON_RECURSIVE_CONTROL — same accumulated info as M4, non-recursive
arm_definitions.M4C: COMPUTE_MATCHED_NON_RECURSIVE_CONTROL — same total compute as M4, non-recursive

configuration.model_agnosticism: No model is hard-coded into architecture code. Routing is operational.

correction_1_adversarial_calibration_ora.description: 35-case adversarial calibration suite MUST NOT obtain ground truth from the evaluator being tested. Use external evidence by category.

PRIOR_ART: same evidentiary standard as existing prior-art oracle
NON_OBVIOUSNESS: cases with documented separation between claimed combination and cited prior art
MECHANISM_VALIDITY_TRANSFER: source literature / device evidence with identifiable mechanism passages

correction_1_adversarial_calibration_ora.acceptance_threshold: >= 80% accuracy on non-ambiguous cases AND no critical category < 70%

correction_2_calibration_acceptance_thre.blocking_condition: If threshold fails: ADVERSARIAL_CALIBRATION_BLOCKED. Do not tune thresholds silently.

correction_3_m4_context_isolation.description: Each M4 round has committed memory files on disk before round begins.

correction_5_boundary_evidence_standard.description: BOUNDARY_CONDITION=KILL requires: specific boundary + failure mechanism + why candidate crosses + EXTERNAL evidence.

correction_6_adversarial_invalid.description: If verdict conflicts with reason OR reason conflicts with evidence standard: ADVERSARIAL_INVALID → EVALUATION_FAILED.

correction_7_source_hash_reconstruction.description: For V3 replay and V4: join candidate.source_ids to Phase-D evidence packet source content_hash.

winning_architecture_requires.lift: >= 5 percentage points over best preregistered comparator

correction_9_boundary_prefilter.description: Deterministic pre-filter before LLM BOUNDARY_CONDITION evaluator.
correction_9_boundary_prefilter.trigger: Conditional language (if, could, might, may) AND no external citation

correction_10_prior_art_firewall.rule: Non-kill states CANNOT become adversarial PRIOR_ART=KILL

definition: absent from both engines' previous-round qualified sets

v4_start_gate.current_status: ADVERSARIAL_CALIBRATION_PENDING — V4 execution blocked until 35-case calibration suite is built and passes >=80% threshold

model_comparison.after_architecture_selection: separate model experiment may compare Mistral vs NVIDIA under the winning architecture

invariants: V3 remains HISTORICAL_PILOT_NOT_PRODUCT_SELECTION — do not change V3 results
Do not generate V4 candidates until all start-gate conditions pass
Do not modify Micro-2 or Macro-1
Adversarial calibration suite must use EXTERNAL evidence, never LLM labels
M4 context isolation requires committed files, not live variables
Evidence→adversarial ordering is hard (skip adversarial if evidence fails)
Prior-art firewall: non-kill states cannot become PRIOR_ART=KILL
Boundary KILL requires external evidence; conditional language without citation is screened
WINNING_ARCHITECTURE requires Fisher exact + Bonferroni p<0.05 + >=5pp lift
